text: Almost every long English word is a root with something attached at each end. Port means carry. Import: carry in. Export: carry out. Transport: carry across. Support: carry from under. Portable: able to be carried. And a reporter is one who carries back the news. Take the word apart and the meaning falls out. Prefixes change the meaning; suffixes change the part of speech.
